title: Investing

status.title: No investment source connected
status.body: No portfolio, brokerage, signal provider, market-data source, or other investment integration is connected. No investment data is being fetched, imported, inferred, or evaluated.

portfolio.title: Portfolio and positions

signals.title: Signals
signals.body: No investment signals, recommendations, or trading guidance are generated.

activity.title: Activity and performance
activity.body: No investment activity or performance information is available to report.
